name: Past webinars grid
purpose: Archives past webinars so a visitor can find and watch a recording.
description: Hairline-bordered block on the legacy "green" theme: centred serif 4rem H2, then a 2-column grid (1 at 479) of fixed-aspect cells (auto height at 991 and below), each with an optional green month-year label, a big day number, a title and a "Watch now ›" link. On hover a photo layer with a 75% black overlay fades in behind the cell. An optional year-pill filter exists (showFilter) but no page enables it.

evidenceNotes: Section id is index.events-past but the component, data-section attribute and pages-manifest.json id are "events-filter"; the original's Finsweet filter UI is hidden and showFilter is never set, so the block is a plain archive grid.
Component comment and default say 52 items; the page passes PAST_WEBINARS with 51 (eventsData.js comment says 51).
Days/months are computed from Date.UTC in eventsData.js; the sample (items 1, 3 and 18 of 51) re-evaluates that expression. `year` is derived data for the hidden filter, not modelled.
